name: Meteor
description: A sky portal of storm cloud tears open and a burning rock falls on the marked ground: fireball, rock debris, a racing shockwave ring and a smouldering crater.

metadata.prompt: lets create the meteor effect, just one basic one is good with impact debris, shockwave ring and aftermath, make sure to include summon sky
metadata.analysis: telegraph: ringed ground marker with a soft rising glow | summon_sky: a tilted storm vortex (raymarched nebula + lit swirling puffs) lit from inside, embers fall, a many-rayed glint | meteor: crust boulders around a lava core on a keyframed rig, fire_sim flame body left behind as a tapering tail, smoke and sparks | impact: flash, fireball, tumbling rock debris with flaming streaks, dust ring, shockwave ring decal | aftermath: scorch, cooling crack web, ring of ground fires, smoke, embers and ash
